summary: list_all now uses /v2 paths, cursor pagination (limit capped at 200, default 200, filters on the first request only, stops when has_more is false), and retries 429/503 up to 4 attempts waiting per Retry-After (seconds or HTTP date) or 2s/1s defaults via sleep/now. Some docs snippets were truncated by the docs service, so fallback wait for a 429 without Retry-After (1s) is inferred.
